command straddle
  --account type=string default="" usage="Embedded account id sent as the Straddle-Account-Id header (Embed platform scoping)"
  --agent type=bool default="false" usage="Set all agent-friendly defaults (--json --compact --no-input --no-color --yes)"
  --allow-partial-failure type=bool default="false" usage="Downgrade response-body partial-failure (e.g. partialFailureError) to a warning instead of a non-zero exit"
  --compact type=bool default="false" usage="Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage"
  --config type=string default="" usage="Config file path"
  --csv type=bool default="false" usage="Output as CSV (table and array responses)"
  --data-source type=string default="auto" usage="Data source for read commands: auto (live with local fallback), live (API only), local (synced data only)"
  --deliver type=string default="" usage="Route output to a sink: stdout (default), file:<path>, webhook:<url>"
  --dry-run type=bool default="false" usage="Show request without sending"
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for straddle"
  --human-friendly type=bool default="false" usage="Enable colored output and rich formatting"
  --idempotent type=bool default="false" usage="Treat already-existing create results as a successful no-op"
  --ignore-missing type=bool default="false" usage="Treat missing delete targets as a successful no-op"
  --json type=bool default="false" usage="Output as JSON"
  --no-cache type=bool default="false" usage="Bypass response cache"
  --no-color type=bool default="false" usage="Disable colored output"
  --no-input type=bool default="false" usage="Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents)"
  --plain type=bool default="false" usage="Output as plain tab-separated text"
  --profile type=string default="" usage="Apply values from a saved profile (see 'straddle profile list')"
  --quiet type=bool default="false" usage="Bare output, one value per line"
  --rate-limit type=float64 default="0" usage="Max requests per second (0 to disable)"
  --select type=string default="" usage="Comma-separated fields to include in output (e.g. --select id,name,status)"
  --timeout type=duration default="30s" usage="Request timeout"
  --yes type=bool default="false" usage="Skip confirmation prompts (for agents and scripts)"

  --charges-max-amount type=float64 default="0" usage="The maximum amount of a single charge."
  --charges-monthly-amount type=float64 default="0" usage="The maximum dollar amount of charges in a calendar month."
  --charges-monthly-count type=int default="0" usage="The maximum number of charges in a calendar month."
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for create"
  --individuals-enable type=bool default="false" usage="Enable"

  --payouts-max-amount type=float64 default="0" usage="The maximum amount of a single payout."
  --payouts-monthly-amount type=float64 default="0" usage="The maximum dollar amount of payouts in a month."
  --payouts-monthly-count type=int default="0" usage="The maximum number of payouts in a month."

  --stdin type=bool default="false" usage="Read request body as JSON from stdin"

  --page-size type=int default="100" usage="Page size.Max value: 1000"

command straddle sync
  --concurrency type=int default="4" usage="Number of parallel sync workers"
  --db type=string default="" usage="Database path (default: ~/.local/share/straddle/data.db)"
  --full type=bool default="false" usage="Full resync (ignore previous checkpoint)"
  --global-param type=stringArray default="[]" usage="Extra query param to inject into every sync request including dependent path-scoped calls (repeatable, key=value). Use when an API requires a scope on every call regardless of path nesting."
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for sync"
  --latest-only type=bool default="false" usage="Refresh head of each resource only; clears resume cursor and caps pages at 1. Mutually exclusive with --since (--since wins)."
  --max-pages type=int default="100" usage="Maximum pages to fetch per resource (0 = unlimited; cap-hit emits a sync_warning event)"
  --param type=stringArray default="[]" usage="Extra query param to inject into flat-list sync requests (repeatable, key=value). Skipped on path-scoped dependent requests so a top-level scope like workspace=<id> does not double up on /parents/<id>/children calls. Use --global-param to inject everywhere. Avoid pagination keys (limit/since/cursor) — overriding them corrupts resume state."
  --path-context type=stringArray default="[]" usage="Fill a {key} placeholder in BaseURL or request paths from a supplied value (repeatable, key=value). Wins over env-resolved Config.TemplateVars values, so it doubles as a one-off override at the call site. Use it when an env variable already holds a different value, or when the spec did not annotate the placeholder with an env var."
  --resource-param type=stringArray default="[]" usage="Per-resource extra query param (repeatable, resource:key=value). Wins over --param and --global-param when keys conflict."
  --resources type=stringSlice default="[]" usage="Comma-separated resource types to sync. Naming a parent also runs its parent-keyed dependents (see Long help for scoping)."
  --since type=string default="" usage="Incremental sync duration (e.g. 7d, 24h, 1w, 30m)"
  --strict type=bool default="false" usage="Exit non-zero on any per-resource failure (default: only critical failures or all-resource failure exit non-zero)."

command straddle version
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for version"
command straddle which
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for which"
  --limit type=int default="3" usage="Maximum number of matches to return"
command straddle workflow
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for workflow"
command straddle workflow archive
  --db type=string default="" usage="Database path (default: ~/.local/share/straddle/data.db)"
  --full type=bool default="false" usage="Full re-archive (ignore previous sync state)"
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for archive"
command straddle workflow status
  --db type=string default="" usage="Database path"
  --help type=bool default="false" usage="help for status"
